ALLCAPS-Droid/xin-wen-lian-bo.description: Automated transcripts of the CCTV "Xinwen Lianbo" (Evening News) and its Node.js-based crawler source code, using GitHub Actions to push them to specified email addresses, while also providing an RSS feed.
ALLCAPS-Droid/xin-wen-lian-bo.body:
# 📺 Automated Push System for Xinwen Lianbo Transcripts

This project is a purely automated news retrieval and distribution tool based on GitHub Actions. Every day at 21:00, the system automatically fetches the full transcript of that day's 《新闻联播》(Xinwen Lianbo), converts and formats it, and then pushes it to your devices through multiple channels, so you can read the daily official media news in an elegant and efficient way, like 「批阅奏章」(reviewing memorials).

## ✨ Core Highlights

* 🤖 **Extreme Automation**: Breaks the delay curse of GitHub's default scheduler, supports precise triggering via external APIs, ensuring the news arrives every day exactly on time.
* 📧 **Elegant Email Push**: No longer plain text! Automatically converts Markdown into HTML emails with injected custom CSS styles. Font size, line spacing, and bold text are perfectly adapted to mainstream email clients (and uses BCC to protect privacy).
* 📡 **Modern RSS Subscription**: Automatically generates a `feed.xml` with a dedicated logo. Optimized for users in China, providing multiple subscription paths to completely solve update delays.
* 🆓 **Truly Zero-Cost Deployment**: No need to purchase or maintain any servers. Relying on GitHub Actions' free compute, free third-party Cron services, and free SMTP from major email providers, it runs perfectly.

---

## 🚀 Quick Deployment Guide

With just a few simple steps, you can have your own automated news push system.

### Step 1: Fork This Project
Click the **Fork** button in the upper right corner of the page to copy this project to your own GitHub account.

### Step 2: Enable Repository Read and Write Permissions
To allow the bot to automatically save the generated news files and RSS feed:
1. Go to your forked repository and click `Settings` at the top.
2. In the left menu, find `Actions` -> `General`.
3. Scroll down to **Workflow permissions**, select `Read and write permissions`, and save.

### Step 3: Configure GitHub Secrets (Email Keys)
To send emails securely, we need to configure your email information in GitHub.
Go to `Settings` -> `Secrets and variables` -> `Actions`, click `New repository secret`, and add the following three variables in turn:

| Name | Secret Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| `MAIL_USERNAME` | Your sending email account (e.g., `your_email@qq.com`) |
| `MAIL_PASSWORD` | Your sending email **SMTP authorization code** (note: not the login password!) |
| `MAIL_TO` | The email address that receives the news (can be the same as the sending email; multiple addresses are supported, separated by commas) |

BUAASubnet/UBAA.description: A better Smart BUAA. Make BUAA Great Again!
BUAASubnet/UBAA.body:
# UBAA

**Smart BUAA Remake: An all-in-one campus assistant for BUAA students**

Timetables, assignments, grades, course selection, reservations, schedules, and cloud storage, all in one app.

[**Download and Usage Guide**](https://github.com/BUAASubnet/UBAA/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md#用户) · [Feature Overview](#功能一览) · [Issue Feedback](https://github.com/BUAASubnet/UBAA/issues)

---

## Why Choose UBAA

- 📚 **One entry point**: No need to switch between a dozen campus systems. Check timetables, see assignment deadlines before submitting, grab Boya (博雅) courses, and book seats, all in the same app.
- 📱 **All platforms**: Works on phones, tablets, and computers, supporting Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- 🌐 **Works on and off campus**: Automatically chooses between a direct connection and the school's WebVPN, and recovers automatically when the network changes.
- 📴 **Available offline**: Opens showing your last loaded content first, so you can still view timetables and grades without a network connection.
- 🔒 **Campus data is handled directly on your device**: Campus requests are not relayed through UBAA servers. If you select “Remember password,” your password is stored in the system's secure storage.

## Feature Overview

| | Feature | What you can do |
|---|---|---|
| 🗓️ | **Schedule and to-dos** | Timetables, assignment deadlines, and your own plans in one timeline; supports recurring rules, teaching weeks, and completion marks; can be exported to the system calendar |
| 📖 | **Study** | Timetables, exams, grades, empty classrooms, SPOC and Xiji (希冀) assignments, daily courses, and course evaluations |
| 🎓 | **Boya courses** | Browse, filter, enroll in, and drop courses |
| 🏛️ | **Campus services** | Library seat booking, seminar room reservations, Sunshine check-in, iHome requests, and income/finance inquiries |
| ☁️ | **BUAA Cloud Drive** | Browse and manage files; upload, download, and share; recycle bin; can also sync schedules across multiple devices |
| ⌨️ | **Desktop command mode** | Check timetables, view grades, and manage schedules in the terminal, sharing the same account as the desktop app |

Detailed usage for each feature is in the feature overview of the [User Documentation](https://github.com/BUAASubnet/UBAA/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md#用户).

## Quick Start

1. Download the installer for your platform from [Releases](https://github.com/BUAASubnet/UBAA/releases). Make sure to choose the **v2.x** version.
2. Open the app and sign in with your BUAA unified authentication account. Select “Auto” for the connection method.
3. After signing in, go to the home page. All features are in the bottom navigation bar (phone) or sidebar (computer).

BeniaBot/tiknick.body:
# 📋 Tik-Nick (טיקניק)

**A Hebrew desktop application for managing and tracking usernames ("nicks") on forums.**
All data is stored locally on your computer — full privacy.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📇 Nick management
Consolidate usernames with full details (real name, phone, email, address, groups, reputation, status, notes, and more), in table or card view. Includes additional contacts, private notes, and bulk deletion/editing.

### 🔗 Linked identities
Link nicks that represent the same person across different forums, with transitive identity groups.

### 🎖️ Source and reliability mechanism
Each value is attributed to a source (me / scan / import) with a reliability rank; the most reliable value wins. ❗ marks conflicting information, with an option for manual resolution.

### 🔍 Advanced search and filtering
Fast search across all fields (FTS5), and multi-condition filtering (for example: name contains "משה" **and** address contains "בני ברק") with bulk actions on the results.

### 🌐 Internet synchronization
Scanning of **NodeBB and Discourse** forums via the official API — fetching extended details, scanning all forums in sequence with automatic skipping, page limits, and login cookies that are saved automatically for each forum. Dozens of Haredi forums are built into the list.

### 🔎 Unified user view
Typing a name shows a consolidated view of all information about that person — including from all identities linked to them across the different forums.

CCS-HQ/lanflow.body:
# Lanflow

A desktop proxy client built on the native MyGo UI, using Mihomo (Clash.Meta) as its core. It supports **system proxy** and **TUN mode** on macOS and Windows.

For the interface and features, see the [design document](https://github.com/CCS-HQ/lanflow/blob/HEAD/docs/design.md). For an interactive prototype, see [docs/prototype/index.html](https://github.com/CCS-HQ/lanflow/blob/HEAD/docs/prototype/index.html). For development, CI, and releases, see [docs/development.md](https://github.com/CCS-HQ/lanflow/blob/HEAD/docs/development.md).

## Installation

Download from the [latest Release](https://github.com/CCS-HQ/lanflow/releases/latest):

- **macOS**: For Apple silicon, choose `lanflow-<version>-arm64.dmg`. For Intel, choose `-amd64.dmg`. Drag Lanflow into “Applications”. The installer is not signed or notarized by Apple, so macOS will block it on first launch. Either click “Open Anyway” under “System Settings › Privacy & Security”, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Lanflow.app` in the Terminal.
- **Windows**: Run `lanflow-setup-<version>-amd64.exe`. The installer is unsigned. If SmartScreen appears, click “More info › Run anyway”.

### Verifying the download

Each Release includes `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Place it in the same directory as the installer, then run:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing     # macOS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing         # Linux, Git Bash
```

In Windows PowerShell, you can use `Get-FileHash .\lanflow-setup-<version>-amd64.exe -Algorithm SHA256` and compare the result with the value in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

The installers are built by GitHub Actions and include a build provenance attestation. To confirm that an installer came from this repository's release workflow, you can use the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/):

# APKUpdater OSS

**Open-source update manager for Android apps from independent stores and git repositories**

---

**APKUpdater OSS** helps you find, download, and install updates for Android apps without being tied to a single store. The app polls selected sources in parallel, groups identical updates into a single card, and lets you precisely control where and which versions are installed.

The project is a heavily reworked fork of the original [APKUpdater](https://github.com/rumboalla/apkupdater) by [rumboalla](https://github.com/rumboalla). Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
```

TianLin0509/ai-hub-huawei.body:
# AI HUB-Huawei · Beta Pioneer Edition (CodeAgent)

> **⚠️ Downloads and updates are available only on the internal company source:** The latest version is published only on the internal company source platform (OpenX, search for **AI Hub** (project name AI HUB-Huawei)). The GitHub page no longer receives new releases and is kept only as a historical archive (frozen at v5.6.107). Please download and install from the internal company source; after that, update in-app with one click.

This brings the company intranet's **Code Agent CLI** into a Windows desktop workbench: standalone sessions, multi-AI group chats, card view, hibernation and resume, history search, and automatic naming. This is the company edition of AI Hub (product name AI HUB-Huawei, Beta Pioneer Edition). The current version is **v5.6.125**, synced from upstream **1.6.738** (see `community-edition.json` for the specific commit).

It is the same codebase as the public community edition. The only difference is that the default behavior is tailored to the company intranet:

- **If Code Agent is installed, it is used by default**: New sessions select CodeAgent by default and place it first, and new group chats default to two CodeAgent members (GLM-5.2-WX-Auto and MiniMax-M2.7).
- **New folders are trusted and run without confirmation by default**: On startup, it runs with `--skip-safe-check` and pre-writes trust. The permission mode defaults to `bypassPermissions` (no confirmation). In the launch center, you can change it per tool to “auto-edit files”, “confirm each step”, or “discuss only, no changes”. CodeAgent also has “auto-decide”, and Codex can use “confirm each step” (read-only sandbox with on-demand approval). It runs with `--disable-update`, so upgrade prompts won't block it.
- **The model follows the local CodeAgent**: The model list is read from the local CodeAgent configuration (GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, etc., depending on each person's permissions). In a session, click the model below the input box to switch. Hub restarts CodeAgent with the new model in the same original session, and the conversation history is kept. The interface shows the model actually used for each reply, and the avatar and sidebar icon also change with the model.
- **PowerShell terminal**: In the launch center, besides CodeAgent, you can also directly create a PowerShell terminal session.
- **Resume history sessions in any directory**: Launch center → “Resume session” → CodeAgent lists CodeAgent history from all directories (CodeAgent's own `/resume` only lists the current directory). Click an entry to continue the chat in its original directory.
- **No external API key required**: Automatic naming of sessions and group chats uses Code Agent's own single-question mode.
- In light theme, the CodeAgent terminal is dark overall, matching the CLI's own black background.
- The account page does not automatically read other CLI accounts already logged in on the local machine. When needed, click “Check / Log in” yourself.

小瓦's Codex text reports are launched by the DSH process service. It uses the local Codex login session and runs in a temporary directory in read-only mode. Users who previously used Codex only through an environment-variable API key can log in to Codex locally first, or choose a DSH model before authorizing. Regular document conversion and preview use a separate environment-variable allowlist.

WeChat (微信) QR-code login and the image and video APIs remain integrated in the same workbench plugin. When these features run, the workbench uses the corresponding WeChat token or media service key. The early 即梦 (Jimeng) connection remains compatible with the sessionId stored locally.

The sidebar and panels consistently use the 小瓦 mark. The current stable version is 0.59.3.

WTT Creation Workbench (`@wtt/dsh-creation-workbench`) is an open-source AI canvas for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that can organize materials and produce PPTs, images, and videos. Cross-canvas creation, review, and revision can be handed to **小瓦 · WTT 项目助手** (Super Agent), or you can scan a QR code to connect the **WeChat Bot** (微信 Bot) and, from your phone, give 小瓦 tasks, confirm plans, and review results.

## Core Features (核心功能)

The screenshots below come from the same demo project, 「城市夜行」(City Night Walk).

### 小瓦 (Xiaowa)

Click W below 「添加素材」(Add Materials) on the left side of the canvas, and hand a goal to 小瓦, for example 「整理访谈、写提案，再做成 PPT」(organize interviews, write a proposal, then turn it into a PPT). The assistant breaks the goal down and, based on dependencies, dispatches steps to different canvases in the same project. You can review the full process under 「委托」(Delegations), open the original task conversation, handle questions, or take over a step.

aiqinxuancai/AutoLinker.description: AutoLinker support library for 易语言 (E language), providing AI Agent and MCP services. It also supports using different Linkers for different source files, and automatic switching between dynamic and static ec during debug compilation.
aiqinxuancai/AutoLinker.body:
AutoLinker is an AI Agent support library for 易语言 (E language). Through reverse engineering, it lets AI fully automatically write code: it finds and reads the relevant code based on your requirements, then directly edits, modifies, and inserts code.

It also provides a local MCP service that connects the 易语言 IDE to tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI, allowing them to call it for fully automated E language coding (see the MCP section below).

> 📖 [易语言 × AI Agent Practice White Paper](https://github.com/aiqinxuancai/Awesome-E-Agent) ·
> 📖 [e-packager: unpack .e files into txt for editing, then repackage](https://github.com/aiqinxuancai/e-packager)

The repository also includes the [EideCore standalone project and compilation core](https://github.com/aiqinxuancai/AutoLinker/blob/HEAD/EideCore/README.md): three x86 projects share a relocatable COFF core to generate native DLLs, static LIBs, and Console applications. They load, serialize, and compile projects within the current process, without requiring the original IDE EXE or a side-by-side core DLL. The linker, support libraries, and so on are provided through external directories. It is currently still an experimental implementation that has not completed GUI dead-code removal or relocation auditing.

## Quick Start

After downloading the Release, put `AutoLinker.fne` into the 易语言 `lib` directory and enable the support library.

The minimum supported version is 易语言 **5.6 / x86**, with 5.95 as the main development environment. Actual operation must pass ABI layout and entry validation. The window transaction has been tested on 5.6, 5.71, 5.95, and the 5.95 enhancement patch v1.1. The 5.93→5.95 official patch has only completed ABI verification; runtime verification is limited by dongle authorization. Unknown versions are not automatically allowed based on version number. See the [compatibility report](https://github.com/aiqinxuancai/AutoLinker/blob/HEAD/docs/test-results/restore-abi-compatibility-20261108/README.md) for details.

> 🔧 [AI / MCP feature configuration guide (API Key, relay services, per-platform setup)](https://github.com/aiqinxuancai/AutoLinker/blob/HEAD/CONFIG.md)
>
> 📊 Before choosing a model, you can check the [易语言 LLM benchmark scores](https://e-language-bench.apptest.dev), which compare real response packets with headless compilation results.

---

---

## 中文

### 这个插件做什么

它负责两件事：把一段文字送进**系统提示词**，把一段对话送进**上下文**。为了说清楚，本文与插件设置界面统一使用两个叫法：

| 叫法 | 指的是 |
| --- | --- |
| **人设正文** | 注入系统提示词的那段内容 |
| **历史对话** | 作为上下文注入的一段“已经发生过”的对话 |

两者按**人设**成对保存：在设置页把人设正文和历史对话写好、存成一条预设“人设”，之后在对话里选中这条人设，两者按各自的规则进入这一次请求。

### 注入的规则

**人设正文**进入系统提示词的**人设段**，**注入位置可自行编辑**：“段序权重”决定这一段排在系统提示词的哪个位置。

- **数值**：按权重大小排序，**数字越小越靠前**（默认 `-1`，排在预设里那句 "You are a coding agent…" 之前）。
- **追随**：点“追随”后，人设段被放到**所有系统提示词段之后**。
- 权重只影响排序，**永远不会混进人设正文**；每条人设各自保存自己的权重，编辑框跟着当前选中的那条人设走。
- 必须填整数（`-1000000000` ~ `1000000000`）：小数、指数、带单位都会被拒绝保存。

**历史对话**在**新对话的第一步**作为 user 侧上下文注入一次，并按仿照 DSH 自身注入的格式包裹：

- 整段包进一对 `<system-reminder>`，开口之后是 `CONTEXT_ROAD:`，结尾是 `CONTINUE_CONTEXT.`；正文里出现的收尾标签会被转义，保证壳子不会被提前闭合。
- 往期对话的 user 侧内容包在 `<user_message>` 里；模型侧的思考包在 `<thinking>` 里、说的话包在 `<assistant_message>` 里；双方非对话内容包在 `<file>` 之类的标记里；压缩摘要保持 `<compacted-summary>…</compacted-summary>` 原样。

**已经注入过的对话不会重复注入**（那会把整段对话的缓存读取推倒重来）。所以历史对话只在每个新对话的第一步生效；如果想让一个已经聊起来的对话也带上历史，只能把历史写进人设正文——但效果不好，不推荐。

kgnbkgnb666/Aura.body:
# ✨ Aura

### An elegant voice input tool

Speak and it types. Aura recognizes your speech, organizes your expression, and writes the result into the current editor.

It can replace Typeless and Qianwen IME as a lightweight voice entry point for daily work.

## Features

- Press right Alt to start recording, press again to stop
- Results are automatically written at the current cursor or copied to the clipboard
- Automatically follows the screen where the current input box is located and shows an elegant floating window
- Voice organization and selection rewriting
- Remove AI-style wording and Prompt Engineering Skill
- Voice translation
- Real-time microphone waveform detection
- Dictation history and personal dictionary

The model services are fixed to Doubao streaming ASR 2.0 and `doubao-seed-2-0-mini-260428`. We compared speed, latency, and cost, and chose the combination that responds faster, has lower latency, and is more affordable.

## Quick Start

1. Download and install the latest version of Aura.
2. Open Settings and go to Model Services.
3. Enter the Doubao ASR API Key and the Volcano Ark API Key.
4. Click Test Connection.
5. In any input box, press right Alt to start speaking, then press right Alt again to write.

## Apply for Two API Keys

### Volcano Ark LLM Key

1. Register and log in to the [Volcano Ark Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:cn-beijing).
2. Open "Activation Management" on the left and activate the Doubao Seed 2.0 Mini text model.
3. Open "API Key Management" and click "Create API Key".
4. Fill in a note and create it, then copy the generated Key. The Key is usually shown in full only once, so save it immediately.
5. Return to Aura's "Settings → Model Services" and paste it into "Volcano Ark API Key".

The Ark API endpoint is `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3`. Aura already uses `doubao-seed-2-0-mini-260428` fixed.

### Doubao Streaming ASR 2.0 Key

1. Register and log in to the [Doubao Speech Console](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/app).
2. Go to "Activation Management" and activate "Streaming Speech Recognition 2.0".
3. At the bottom left, open "API Key" and click to create or get an API Key.
4. Copy the generated Key and return to Aura's "Settings → Model Services".
5. Paste it into "Doubao ASR API Key" and save.

Aura uses the real-time endpoint `wss://openspeech.bytedance.com/api/v3/sauc/bigmodel_async` with resource ID `volc.seedasr.sauc.duration`.

Please keep both Keys safe. Do not commit them to GitHub or share them with others.

# KixDNS Panel

**Simplified Chinese** | [English](https://github.com/tuoro/kixdns-panel/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

A web panel for self-hosted DNS. Configure split-routing rules and blocklists with forms, and see for every query which rule it matched and who answered. The core is KixDNS, written in Rust. It installs with one command, or you can [try it online](https://tuoro.github.io/kixdns-panel/) first: no installation needed, it uses sample data, and changes are reset on refresh.

## Features

- **Overview**: query volume, success rate, cache hit rate, latency and hourly trends, upstream status, request distribution, rule hits, and query rankings
- **Configuration management**: rules, upstream groups, domain mappings, blocklists, and basic settings are edited with forms, or you can edit the JSON directly. GeoIP/GeoSite data is hosted (the full package bundles GeoSite). KixDNS validates changes before saving, hot-reload failures roll back automatically, and version history is kept
- **Blocklists**: subscribe to AdGuard and Adblock format blocklists and hosts files, or write your own rules. Lists update daily or weekly. If a download fails, the last successful version stays in use and is labeled with its date
- **Query logs**: for each query, see which client it came from, which rule it matched, who answered, and what was returned, step by step through the processing. Search by domain or client, filter by destination, and download. Retention period and maximum disk usage are configurable and never exceed the device's remaining space
- **DNS diagnostics**: send queries to the local KixDNS, optionally specifying a client IP, and see step by step which rules, cache, and upstreams were hit. When editing rules, you can test an unsaved draft first
- **Runtime logs and audit trail**: view KixDNS runtime logs in real time. Every action taken in the panel is recorded
- **Kernel updates**: update KixDNS from the panel to the latest dated release from the fork, or roll back to the previous one. Failed activations recover automatically
- **Panel self-update**: update to the latest stable release with one click on the System page, with double checksum verification. KixDNS is not touched
- **OpenWrt**: install on a router with one command. When KixDNS starts, it takes over port 53, while dnsmasq continues to manage DHCP and LAN hostnames as usual
- **Docker**: one container and one data directory. The panel and kernel can still be updated online from the panel, and DNS stays up when the panel is updated
- **Security**: Argon2id authentication, HttpOnly sessions, CSRF protection, and login rate limiting. In the systemd and Docker versions, the panel and kernel do not run as root
- Usable on desktop and mobile

wangz-code/ddo-tts.description: Built-in EdgeTTS read-aloud / mimoTTS (custom intonation is fun). Text-to-speech needs no extra deployment: install and listen. The speech engine is based on rany2/edge-tts, which is not very stable. Zhang Xue is awesome.
wangz-code/ddo-tts.body:
# TTS speech engine

## ddo-tts/Built-in EdgeTTS Microsoft Read Aloud
- Edgetts based on rany2/edge-tts https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts ✅
- Xiaomi MIMO speech synthesis https://mimo.mi.com/models/zh-CN/mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone (free for a limited time)
- If you are a new MIMO user registering, you can enter my invite code: Y2QCPB

### Why does this repo exist?
- I once submitted a PR that sat unmerged for several weeks. So waht ever! Me=null, Me+GPT=omnipotent
- I had this need myself: I couldn't fall asleep at night without listening to a few chapters. Installing a separate TTS is somewhat redundant, since the so-called TTS engines are essentially still rany2/edge-tts
- Local ebook recommendation: https://github.com/BlankRain/ebooks

### Main changes
- Changed how audio streams are staged (writing to disk => writing to memory)
- The original author cached audio on disk, with frequent writes and deletes (one write per paragraph).
- Frequent writes may affect storage lifespan, though for modern storage the impact is probably negligible 😋. But I moved it into memory, releasing the media for each chapter once it has been read.
- Follows rany2/edge-tts EdgeVersion 143.0.3650.75

~~Merged upstream updates irregularly; the most recent was 2026-05-08.~~ The upstream repo has been deleted and has run off. I suspect that if someone went inside, everyone here bears some responsibility. Once inside, there's food and drink, and you still get paid to treadle sewing machines.

### happy every day 😄 😄 If this helps you, you can buy me a cup of Mixue lemonade. Thanks!

### Xiaomi Mimo TTS requires you to register your own key (free for a limited time). There are two ways to use it:
> #### 1. Presets: pre-trained voices, similar to Microsoft's Xiaoxiao. Xiaomi's option here is Bingtang Molihua (冰糖茉莉).

> #### 2. Custom: you can customize the intonation through text, such as the examples below. Use your imagination and craft your own voice (recommended).

yangyongyongyong/llm-protocol-gateway.description: LLM protocol conversion gateway with Cloudflare public access and provider OAuth
yangyongyongyong/llm-protocol-gateway.body: A gateway that unifies the four protocols OpenAI Chat / OpenAI Responses / Claude / Gemini, API Keys, official subscriptions, and third-party relays into a single controllable, observable, and disaster-tolerant gateway. --- ## What problems it solves - **Protocol mismatch**: Clients only speak OpenAI Chat, while upstreams only offer Claude / Gemini / Responses. The gateway does point-to-point direct conversion without going through a lossy intermediate layer. - **Scattered accounts**: Official API Keys, Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor subscriptions, Qoder/Trae/ZCode/WorkBuddy accounts, and others are unified under the same Provider and key system. - **Manual switching is always needed**: When one upstream is rate-limited, banned, or goes offline, the whole chain breaks. The gateway includes fallback chains, cooldowns, failback probing, and session stickiness. - **Unclear spending**: Pricing tables are configured per model, each request is billed down to the micro-dollar, and combined with per-key quotas and usage analytics, costs and quotas are laid out openly. One Go core with one shared frontend. It can run as a **Docker / K8s service** or be packaged as a **macOS menu bar app**. --- ## 🖼️ Interface Preview > Screenshots are taken from a live running gateway. Account emails, organization names, usernames, server addresses, and similar details have been redacted, while request volumes and amounts are kept as original. ### Input Providers: all upstreams on one page Cards directly show subscription quotas, refresh times, availability status, and failure reasons. A filter at the top lets you filter by connection method. Selected items can be batch exported or imported (including OAuth credentials), and you can also run model sync, chat testing, and check-in on an individual account. ### API Keys: one Key, multiple forwarding plans A single key can store multiple complete plans (preferred Provider, fallback chain, model mapping, thinking depth), and selecting one takes effect immediately. The four tabs on the right manage, respectively: forwarding plans and disaster-recovery chains; binding relationships and model overrides; client configuration and call examples; and quota and usage governance.
